dishes.name: Mengen pilavı
dishes.desc: Pilaf with lamb, mushrooms, walnuts, tomatoes and dill, served with ayran. It takes its name from the Mengen district, home of Türkiye's famous cooks.

dishes.name: Ovmaç soup
dishes.desc: Winter soup with onion, mince and tomato paste, thickened with hand-rubbed pieces of flour-and-egg dough. One of Bolu's best-known soups.

dishes.name: Saray helvası
dishes.desc: Dry, layered halva topped with pistachios, a classic Bolu gift sweet. Sources tie it to Mudurnu in Bolu province.

dishes.name: Abant kebabı
dishes.desc: Whole smoked aubergine stuffed with lamb, mushrooms, onion, tomato and pepper, often topped with grated cheese. Named after the lake in Bolu's hills.

dishes.name: Kedi batmaz
dishes.desc: Cornmeal cooked in boiling water with molasses, spooned out and eaten with butter, walnuts and molasses. A Mengen dish whose odd name means that a cat would not sink in it.
